g.text: P135 — Paid work and observed intervention
All modes pay host observation/capture costs. Actual automatic notice exposure, entity rows and explicit queries are separate.
Entity-row exposure is cumulative across paid actor requests, not the number of unique entities or completed obligations.
A capture without subsequent model dispatch is not exposure. Explicit query replies enter ordinary paid history; the table counts requests.
Run-scoped handles/hash values differ between modes: the first input divergence cannot be attributed to entity content alone.
Host seconds overlap work/session time and are not added again. Bytes are never converted to tokens. Enumeration is not official success.
